description: Form view widget, data-bound via the flow_type/flow_id/view_id trio.
notes: The live working view/form ships view_id=null, plus instance_id=null and activity_instance_id=null — this is why view_id is OPTIONAL for view/form in WIDGET_REQUIRED_CONFIG (unlike every other view/* slug, where it stays required): a truthy requirement would make this exact live binding unreachable. The flow/report binding is double-encoded (Data AND FieldMapping) — flow_type/flow_id also live in Component.Data, same convention widget_metrics/widget_general_masterdetail already prove. view_id is NOT mirrored into Data here (it is null).

A page-hosted view/form widget auto-creates a fresh junk Draft item on every render it is shown to a user — this inflates the flow's Draft item count over time purely from people viewing the page, not from real submissions.
ALL view/* widgets bind via this same flow_type/flow_id/view_id trio, regardless of which visual the widget renders — only Script.web (and Data.manifest_id/visualization_type) differ between them.

A data-bound widget renders per the BOUND VIEW's own type, not the widget's name: e.g. a view bound to "myitems" (a table-type view) shows a table inside a kanban/timeline/matrix widget until a matching view TYPE actually exists on the flow — this is expected, not a bug in the widget.

Data-bound widgets obey the sticky "Viewing as" role lens in the builder — an access-denied render usually means the LENS role lacks permission on the bound flow/view, not that the widget itself is broken.

Real ids typically use the manifest_id prefix only on a fresh single-widget add (e.g. `Button_<10-char-rand>`, `Metrics_<10-char-rand>`) — the scenario this template mints for — while built-up production pages (`all_pages_draft_20260806.json`) mostly carry the generic `Component_<rand>` id instead, and Repeater/Tab/MasterDetail/Breadcrumbs were never observed prefixed at all.
